# vappcloud_compute_instance (Resource)

A cloud compute instance attached to a pre-created VAppCloud device. Enrollment bootstrap material is injected server-side and never returned to Terraform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_connection_id` (String) Preconfigured cloud connection ID.
- `device_id` (String) Pre-created logical device ID.
- `image` (String) Cloud image slug or ID.
- `name` (String) Compute instance name.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID.
- `region` (String) Cloud region slug.
- `size` (String) Cloud size slug.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `default_vmm_id` (String) Default VMM established by the connected agent.
- `id` (String) Opaque public resource identifier.
- `resource_version` (Number) Optimistic concurrency version.
- `state` (String) Provisioning/readiness state.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp in RFC3339 format.
